title: Shadownet A2A Message Envelope
description: Schema for the `data` of a part with type `shadownet/v1+envelope`. See RFC-0006. Mirrored from ../shadownet-specs/schemas/messages/envelope.schema.json — kept in sync via tools/check-schemas.sh.
